articles.summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. ("Peoples") (NASDAQ: PEBO) today announced results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. Net income totaled $21.2 million for the second quarter of 2025, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.59. In comparison, Peoples reported net income of $24.3 million, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.68, for the first quarter of 2025 and net income of $29.0 million, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.82, for the second quarter of 2024.
articles.title: PEOPLES BANCORP INC. ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER 2025 RESULTS
